message: Architecture block discovery paused before VHDL generation. The reviewer judged the auto-discovered block contracts as a poor fit.

issues.message: Discovered blocks: pattern_pixel_generator, pattern_framebuffer_internal. Missing blocks after review: horizontal_timing_counter, vertical_timing_counter, sync_generation_logic, active_video_window, top_level_video_integration. Risks: Absence of pixel-domain timing counters prevents deterministic sync generation; Missing active-video window detection risks driving outputs during blanking intervals; No sync generation logic violates mandatory video timing requirements; Top-level integration wrapper is required to coordinate timing, sync, and pixel data paths.
